entries.description: A procedure to call when a dialog has an answer. Question passes the answer and the additional value to that procedure on the module. OpenForm does not take one: a form is not closed back into the caller.
entries.parameters: procedureName — the procedure. module — the object that has it. additionalParameters — passed after the answer. The module and the extra value may be omitted.
entries.example:
notify = New NotifyDescription("Handler", ThisObject);
Question("Save?", QuestionMode.YesNo, notify);
